description: Files sitting in the IES root directory were not moved to their canonical locations as part of session cleanup. Chase was spawned to file Spring Line Advisory materials but was not given the explicit instruction to check for and relocate root-level files. Master should have identified loose files in root before spawning and included that in the task payload.
correction: Before closing any session, run `ls` on the IES root and move any non-canonical files to their proper locations. Include root-file cleanup explicitly in every Chase or Knox spawn payload when filing work.
systemic_fix: Session shutdown checklist must include: list IES root, identify any loose files (PDFs, decks, notes), and route to appropriate agent for filing before commit.
